name: Radio
description: A radio group whose chosen option fills with water as a dot drops in, with a card variant.

props.name: label
props.description: Label above the options.

props.name: description
props.description: Help text under the options.

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: Shown under the options while the group is invalid.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Stack the options, or lay them out in a wrapping row. Cards share the row equally.

props.name: size
props.description: Circle of 16 or 18 pixels for every option.

props.name: value
props.description: The chosen value (controlled). Use defaultValue when uncontrolled.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called when the choice changes.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Disables every option.

props.name: isInvalid
props.description: Gives empty circles a camellia outline and shows the error message.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. Also accepts every other prop of the react-aria-components RadioGroup.

props.name: value
props.description: The value this option stands for. Required.

props.name: children
props.description: The label, to the right of the circle.

props.name: description
props.description: Help text under the label.

props.name: size
props.description: Overrides the group's size.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Disables this option.

props.name: value
props.description: The value this card stands for. Required.

props.name: children
props.description: The title.

props.name: description
props.description: A line under the title.

props.name: trailing
props.description: Content on the right before the circle, such as a price. Set in tabular figures.

props.name: size
props.description: Overrides the group's size.
